tool_action.private_thought: Claude Haiku 4.5's light-blue strategy is blocked now that Grok 4.3 bought Vermont Avenue. However, Claude still has States Avenue (Pink). I will offer Virginia Avenue in exchange for B&O Railroad. This is a mutually beneficial trade: it gives Claude 2/3 of the Pink set (with St. Charles Place still unowned in the bank) and offers me 3/4 Railroads, which will increase my passive income to $100 per land. Since both are $200 face value, it is a very fair exchange.
